prompt_intake.description: Convert the original user prompt into structured run inputs.

initial_review_draft.description: Create a verification-ready initial review draft and check it against drafting instructions.

required_markers: | citation_id | citation | PMID | DOI | evidence_role | draft_access_status | venue_trust_label | discovery_provenance | notes |

subsection_retrieval.description: Create subsection-level PubMed query, abstract triage, recall, and full-text routing artifacts.

semantic_abstract_review_preflight.description: Block semantic abstract review unless subsection retrieval is fully ready.

semantic_abstract_review_setup.description: Prepare parallelizable subsection-batched files for semantic abstract review.

semantic_abstract_review_pilot.description: Validate one or more completed semantic abstract-review pilot batches.

semantic_abstract_review_complete.description: Validate complete semantic abstract review after every batch is reviewed and merged into SQLite.

primary_full_text_ingestion.description: Validate Stage 5 primary full-text ingestion, including normalized PMC/PDF outputs or a deliberate manual PDF pause.

full_text_rag_index.description: Validate Stage 6 full-text RAG indexing, including flattened chunks, BM25 lexical index, required vector index, hybrid retrieval config, and SQLite mirrors.

subsection_rag_retrieval.description: Validate Stage 7 subsection-level hybrid RAG retrieval and paper-packet construction.

subsection_rewrite_setup.description: Validate Stage 8 rewrite work-order preparation before writing agents produce rewritten subsections.

subsection_rewrite.description: Validate Stage 8 evidence-grounded subsection rewriting from Stage 7 paper packets.

terminology_normalization.description: Validate Stage 9 entity synonym and terminology normalization before review assembly.

review_assembly.description: Validate Stage 10 assembly of terminology-normalized subsection rewrites into one review draft.

claim_verification_setup.description: Validate Stage 11 claim-verification setup before reviewer agents write decisions.

claim_verification.description: Validate completed Stage 11 claim-level verification decisions.

corrective_rewrite.description: Validate Stage 12 correction of assembled review claims using completed claim-verification decisions.

final_review.description: Validate the terminal reader-facing review and deduplicated reference list.
